faq.q: What is the origin of Aatiya?
faq.a: Aatiya is associated with Arabic. Feminine of عاطي.
Yes — the underlying form عاطية is Arabic.
Aatiya can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
